questionDescription: Instructor-facing discovery summary for genetic-disorder matching practice.
prompt: Match each description to the genetic disorder it best describes.

prompts.text: A condition in females with three copies of the X chromosome
An inherited condition in which blood does not clot properly
Reduced hemoglobin production that can cause severe anemia
A deficiency of the lysosomal enzyme hexosaminidase A

feedback.correct: Correct. Each disorder is paired with its defining chromosome, protein, or enzyme defect.
feedback.incorrect: Review the chromosome, blood, hemoglobin, and lysosomal-enzyme clues.
